# Local patches over the pinned upstream OMP checkout

Generated by `scripts/vendor_omp.py`. Each file is a unified diff against the
upstream `sha` recorded in `OMP_VENDOR.lock`, in apply order.

These are ALREADY baked into the vendored bytes under `vendor/omp/packages/`.
They are kept here so the vendored tree stays reproducible from this repository
alone, instead of only from a gitignored scratch clone's uncommitted working
tree. `scripts/vendor_omp.py --verify` hash-checks every file listed below.

To rebuild the source tree these were vendored from:

```
git clone <upstream> omp-src && cd omp-src
git checkout <sha from OMP_VENDOR.lock>
for p in <repo>/vendor/omp/local-patches/*.patch; do git apply "$p"; done
```

Patches in this series:

- `01-packages__ai__src__auth-storage.ts.patch`
- `02-packages__ai__src__registry__oauth__oauth.html.patch`
- `03-packages__ai__test__callback-server-launch-route.test.ts.patch`
- `04-packages__coding-agent__src__session__agent-storage.ts.patch`
- `05-packages__coding-agent__test__agent-storage-sqlite-compat.test.ts.patch`
